scenario: asking for help with daily routines
english_title: Recognising and Responding to Asking for Help With Daily Routines
vietnamese_title: Giao tiếp nền tảng: daily routines — asking for help with daily routines
primary_communication_goal: recognise and respond to asking for help with daily routines; complete the exchange naturally at A0 / Pre-A1.
context_note_en: Ms Lan asks Ms Sophie to remind her to water the plants today.
context_note_vi: Chị Lan nhờ chị Sophie nhắc mình tưới cây hôm nay.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: Sophie, can you remind me to water the plants today?
turns.vietnamese: Sophie này, chị nhắc tôi tưới cây hôm nay được không?

turns.speaker: Ms Sophie
turns.english: Yes, I will tell you later.
turns.vietnamese: Được chứ, lát nữa tôi nhắc chị.
